name: Insane Forest
storyline:
It all began between the 1970s and 1980s, when a man created lifelike dummies for clothing stores. These dummies were revolutionary—they could move to model outfits on their own. For a time, they were a huge success.

But over the years, something changed. The dummies started acting strangely. Security guards began disappearing during night shifts. Then, two months later, the creator was arrested under mysterious circumstances, and the entire dummy project was shut down.

The dummies were supposed to be destroyed—sent to an incinerator. But one transport never made it. It vanished. A month later, the vehicle was found abandoned and ruined deep in the forest. The police claimed it was a terrorist attack. In reality, it was something far more disturbing...

Years later, between the 2000s and 2010s, you are driving at night to meet someone. Your car runs out of fuel, and you wander into the forest—completely unaware of what’s waiting for you. The dummies never died. They've changed. They're watching.
summary: Insane Forest is a horror indie game set between the 2000s and 2010s. You play as a man stranded after a car crash deep in a haunted forest. Unbeknownst to him, the forest hides a terrifying past. In the late 70s and 80s, a man invented realistic shop dummies that could move on their own. After strange behavior and security guards going missing, the creator was arrested. The dummies were to be destroyed, but one transport truck went missing in the forest—and was later found wrecked, with no sign of the cargo. Now, something lurks among the trees: not human, not machine—skinwalkers born from forgotten creations...
